metadata.datasource: Fotufilm runtime film profile by MUAStudio Inc.; released under CC BY-SA 4.0. Sampled characteristic curves preserve digitized Fujifilm AF3-0258E density records with C1 interpolation. The first and last 12 points of each record provide monotonic extrapolation outside the published range. Runtime rendering data only. See licenses/FILM-PROFILES.txt. Development: FUJIFILM NEOPAN 100 ACROS II data sheet AF3-0258E p3; D-76, 20 C, small tank. Reference time 7 min from the manufacturer datasheet; its curve was checked against that datasheet's graph (Fujifilm AF3-0259E (120 edition), p3, D-76 4/7/10 min: within 0.06 D, line-trace precision).
